slides.headline: OPENAI JUST LET YOUR LAWYER USE AI AND STILL BILL YOU $400 AN HOUR
slides.image_prompt: Sam Altman pitching AI legal tools to skeptical law firm executives, OpenAI logo burning bright, boardroom crackles with tension, saturated palette, high stakes.

caption:
OpenAI just launched a legal AI built specifically for lawyers, not to replace them. Your bill isn't going anywhere. ⚖️

Everyone assumed the whole point of AI hitting law was cheaper legal fees. That was the deal.

OpenAI just launched Astra for Law, their own product built on GPT-6 Astra, their most powerful AI, and sold directly to lawyers and law firms. Their exact description: it's built to "support the expertise and judgment of lawyers." Not replace them. Support them. That one sentence tells you everything.

Next time you're billed $400 an hour, your lawyer can run your entire case through this AI in seconds. The AI does the work. The clock keeps ticking at your rate. The time saved stays in their pocket, not yours. You're basically paying $400 an hour to subsidize their AI subscription.

Astra for Law runs on GPT-6 Astra with custom tools, settings, and legal context built to handle the work inside a law firm. Everyone clocked what it meant. The company everyone was scared would eliminate lawyers just built a product designed to make lawyers more powerful. And more profitable. At your expense.

This isn't AI disrupting law. It's AI making sure the bill never changes.

AI tools are being built FOR professionals, not against them. The firm captures the speed gains every time, and the client just keeps paying. Lawyers today, accountants next.

Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you which side of that trade you want to be on.

Sources: OpenAI on X

#AI #OpenAI #LegalTech #ArtificialIntelligence #Technology
